passed.static_scene: 12 matte black footwear shelves; LED channels instead of spotlight heads; warm beige plaster and walnut furniture; merged architectural batches.
passed.doors: Rigid outward-opening doors with fixed hinges through three poses; both leaf centres swing toward exterior +Z; camera passes through the actual opening; both frames clear the 35mm porch step.
passed.ceiling: Exact v8 geometry, transforms, light positions, counts and light properties verified from Blender source scenes.
passed.look: Full 360 yaw with the reference drag direction and no camera orbit; wheel zoom leaves page scroll unchanged.
passed.walking: Actual visible waypoint click works; paths go around the island; HUD follows manual destinations.
passed.products: An actual proxy hit opens the garment; its mesh rotates continuously and can be added to the local bag.
passed.four_walls: Four directional browser screenshots captured; repeating the same stop retains control and reset preserves the wider FOV.
passed.mobile: Native touch drag and narrow layout work offline without overflow.
passed.normal_motion: Outward entry has intermediate door angles and no roll; the exit turn interpolates yaw continuously.

limitations: Software Chromium tests; draw-call counts are structural measurements, not real-device FPS.
Opposite buildings are a photographic generated backdrop; the pavement, road and curbs are 3D.
Room illumination and resting garment shadows are baked; live LED area lights shade the interactive garments.
